Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. M U MAHMUD Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  Pag  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY Prajit Narzary @ Badal vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48469720/
1  ORDER Date : 21-04-2023 Heard Mr. M. U. Mahmud, learned counsel for the petitioner.
This is an application u/s 438 Cr.P.C for granting pre-arrest bail to the petitioner in connection with Kokrajhar P.S. Case No. 501/2022 u/s 363 /370(i),(iv) /370A(i) /376 (3) of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Prajit Narzary @ Badal vs The State Of Assam And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Such prayer for bail was made on earlier two occasion, which were rejected by this court under its order dated 30.1.2023 passed in AB 87/2023 and order dated 10.3.2023 passed in AB 386/2023.

The court after perusal of the case diary was of the opinion that a girl of 13 years of age was brought by some of her friends from village to town, introduced her to many person including the present petitioner, who had sexual intercourse with her and paid money and money was taken by another lady namely Dipali and the girl was taken from place to place for the same purpose.

It was also finding of this court that though she stated in her statement such sexual intercourse was done with her consent, however such consent is of no value in the eye of law as she is a girl of 13 years of age.
The present application is filed again.
Perused the pleading and material available.
This court finds no new grounds to entertain this bail application.
Accordingly, Anticipatory Bail application stands dismissed.
